item.title: GrandTour: A legged robotics dataset in the wild for multi-modal perception and state estimation
item.description: A field dataset for legged robotics, pairing synchronized multimodal sensing with precise ground truth across 49 missions and varied real-world conditions.

item.title: TRaIL-Odom: Tightly Coupled Continuous Time Radar-IMU-LiDAR Odometry With Adaptive Doppler Weighting
item.description: Radar–IMU–LiDAR odometry that adjusts Doppler constraints to the directions in which LiDAR geometry provides weak localization information.

item.title: BIEVR-LIO: Robust LiDAR-Inertial Odometry through Bump-Image-Enhanced Voxel Maps
item.description: LiDAR odometry that captures small geometric details with oriented height images and concentrates registration on informative parts of the map.

item.title: Holistic Fusion: Task- and Setup-Agnostic Robot Localization and State Estimation With Factor Graphs
item.description: A general factor-graph framework for smooth local motion estimation and globally consistent localization across sensors, reference frames and robot platforms.

item.title: CaRLi-V: Camera–RADAR–LiDAR Point-Wise 3-D Velocity Estimation
item.description: Camera, radar and LiDAR measurements are combined to estimate full 3D velocities at individual points on moving objects.

item.title: One-Shot Badminton Shuttle Detection for Mobile Robots
item.description: Mobile-viewpoint shuttlecock detection with a 20,510-frame, 11-background dataset, semi-automatic annotation and a fine-tuned YOLOv8 detector.

item.title: Large-Scale Autonomous Gas Monitoring for Volcanic Environments: A Legged Robot on Mount Etna
item.description: ANYmal carries a quadrupole mass spectrometer for volcanic gas monitoring. Three autonomous Etna missions report 93–100% autonomy; a separate teleoperated mission sampled natural fumaroles.

item.title: Informed, Constrained, Aligned: A Field Analysis on Degeneracy-Aware Point Cloud Registration in the Wild
item.description: A field comparison of degeneracy mitigation methods for ICP, examining when constraints and regularization improve LiDAR localization.

item.title: Continuous-Time State Estimation Methods in Robotics: A Survey
item.description: A unified review of continuous-time estimation, connecting spline and Gaussian-process formulations with robotic applications and open research questions.

item.title: Boxi: Design Decisions in the Context of Algorithmic Performance for Robotics
item.description: An open sensor payload and design study showing how synchronization, calibration and hardware choices affect localization and mapping.

item.title: ForestLPR: LiDAR Place Recognition in Forests Attentioning Multiple BEV Density Images
item.description: Forest place recognition using attention across LiDAR density images at multiple heights to handle repetitive vegetation and changing conditions.

item.title: Diffusion Based Robust LiDAR Place Recognition
item.description: A diffusion model predicts multiple plausible LiDAR locations in buildings with repeated rooms and floors, using training scans generated from a mesh.

item.title: LEVA: A High-Mobility Logistic Vehicle with Legged Suspension
item.description: A logistics robot with steerable wheels, articulated legged suspension and autonomous loading for carrying heavy payloads over uneven terrain.

item.title: X-ICP: Localizability-Aware LiDAR Registration for Robust Localization in Extreme Environments
item.description: Localizability-aware ICP detects weakly constrained directions and controls the registration update to keep LiDAR localization reliable in difficult geometry.

item.title: Global Path Planning for Autonomous Vehicles in Orchards and Vineyards
item.description: A coverage planner for orchards and vineyards that respects vehicle maneuverability while finding feasible routes within a chosen computation budget.

item.title: Autonomous Forest Inventory with Legged Robots: System Design and Field Deployment
item.description: An integrated legged-robot system for autonomous forest surveying, combining navigation with online tree detection and measurement.

item.title: Scientific exploration of challenging planetary analog environments with a team of legged robots
item.description: A team of legged robots combines terrain traversal, mapping and complementary scientific instruments for exploration in planetary analog environments.

item.title: Deep learning frameworks to learn prediction and simulation focused control system models
item.description: Autoencoder and LSTM architectures for learning compact nonlinear models that support both time-series prediction and free-running simulation.

item.title: Design and development of FOLLY: A self-foldable and self-deployable quadcopter
item.description: A detailed design and experimental study of a quadcopter that folds and deploys its arms using one onboard actuator.

item.title: FOLLY: A Self Foldable and Self Deployable Autonomous Quadcopter
item.description: The original FOLLY prototype introduces automatic arm folding and deployment to improve quadcopter portability and autonomy.
